# What Supabase publishable keys the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every key here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is: the random part is that run written once and then as far as 5,
# which is the twenty-two characters the generator slices out of a base64url
# encoding, and the checksum behind the separator is the first eight of the same
# run. It is the body a secret key carries as well — one generator writes both
# and is told only which prefix to put in front — so what this file states about
# a body is stated in builtin_supabase_secret_key.txt too, and what is its own is
# the prefix and the count that prefix makes: forty-six characters.
#
# The case about a body of underscores alone carries no ordered run, for the
# reason builtin_supabase_secret_key.txt states it for the same case there.

patterns: supabase-publishable-key

# A key as it is written. Supabase says a publishable key is safe to expose and
# prints one into browser code, so what carries one is the client, the bundle
# that client is built into and the configuration either is read from — which is
# why it is a pattern of its own rather than one switch with the secret keys: a
# caller masking a frontend bundle has reason to keep it and a caller masking a
# configuration dump reason to redact it.

case:     a key in an environment assignment
in:       NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key in a client constructor
in:       createClient(url, "sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567")
out:      createClient(url, "«supabase-publishable-key»")

case:     a key in an apikey header
in:       apikey: sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      apikey: «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key in a bearer token header
in:       Authorization: Bearer sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      Authorization: Bearer «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key in the response that lists it
in:       {"api_key":"sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567","type":"publishable"}
out:      {"api_key":"«supabase-publishable-key»","type":"publishable"}

case:     a key at the end of a sentence
in:       the key is sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567.
out:      the key is «supabase-publishable-key».

case:     a key in a yaml value
in:       supabase:\n  publishable_key: sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      supabase:\n  publishable_key: «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key in a query string
in:       https://example.com/?apikey=sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      https://example.com/?apikey=«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key added in a diff
in:       +NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      +NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key in a markdown code span
in:       Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567` in your frontend config.
out:      Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY=«supabase-publishable-key»` in your frontend config.

case:     a key in a ci job log line
in:       [2026-08-17T00:00:00Z] INFO Building with sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      [2026-08-17T00:00:00Z] INFO Building with «supabase-publishable-key»

# The body, which is the secret keys' body exactly: both cases, the digits, the
# hyphen and the underscore throughout, the separator the generator writes
# twenty-three characters behind the prefix, and the two counts read exactly
# rather than as the range the one ruleset reading this prefix reads.

case:     an uppercase random part
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789ABCDEF012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a hyphen in the random part
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789-bcdef012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     an underscore in the random part
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789_bcdef012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a hyphen in the checksum
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456-
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     an underscore in the checksum
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456_
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a body spanning the alphabet
in:       sb_publishable_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV_wxyz-_09
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a dot in the random part
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789.bcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_publishable_0123456789.bcdef012345_01234567

case:     a character outside the alphabet at the first body character
in:       sb_publishable_.123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_publishable_.123456789abcdef012345_01234567

case:     a character outside the alphabet in the checksum
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456.
out:      sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456.

case:     a hyphen where the separator stands
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345-01234567
out:      sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345-01234567

case:     the separator one character late
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef0123450_1234567
out:      sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef0123450_1234567

case:     a body of the right length with no separator
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345001234567
out:      sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345001234567

case:     a body one character short is not a key
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456
out:      sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456

case:     a body run one character longer is a key and the character after it
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_012345678
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»8

# What a key may be written against, which is what the secret keys are held to
# as well: no boundary on either side of the prefix, so a key keeps its span
# whatever character it abuts and what stands past the forty-sixth character
# stays where it was written.

case:     a key after an underscore
in:       SUPABASE_KEY_sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      SUPABASE_KEY_«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key after a letter
in:       xsb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      x«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a word written against a key
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567suffix
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»suffix

# Keys written together, and the key written inside another. The alphabet a body
# is drawn from holds every character the prefix is written with, so a body may
# spell the prefix and open a candidate that reads on past the end of the key it
# stands in. That is why the scan resumes a byte past the start of a candidate
# rather than past the candidate, and the last case is what a scan stepping over
# what it declined would lose: the two spans overlap and are redacted as one.

case:     two keys with nothing between them
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     two keys separated by a space
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567 sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key» «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     three keys with nothing between them
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»«supabase-publishable-key»«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a prefix in front of a key
in:       sb_publishable_sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_publishable_«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a key beginning inside another
in:       sb_publishable_sb_publishable_0123456_01234567012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a body of underscores alone
in:       sb_publishable________________________________
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»

# A key written straight against text of every other shape: a multi-byte rune
# with nothing between it and the key, an invalid byte, a tab and a line
# ending written the network way.

case:     a key immediately against japanese text
in:       日本語sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567日本語
out:      日本語«supabase-publishable-key»日本語

case:     a key immediately followed by an invalid byte
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567\xff\xfe
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»\xff\xfe

case:     a key between tabs
in:       \tsb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567\t
out:      \t«supabase-publishable-key»\t

case:     a key followed by a windows line ending
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567\r\n
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»\r\n

case:     a key cut short by an ellipsis
in:       the key is sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345...
out:      the key is sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345...

# And what this pattern leaves alone. First the prefix: the case the vendor
# writes it in, the underscore it closes with written as a hyphen and then left
# out. Then the secret prefix, which carries the same body behind a shorter one
# and is what the pattern beside this reads — neither reads the other's prefix,
# which is the whole of the boundary between them. Then a body of the right shape
# with no prefix in front of it, and the prose and the log line no pattern here
# has anything to find in.

case:     an uppercase prefix
in:       SB_PUBLISHABLE_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      SB_PUBLISHABLE_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567

case:     a hyphen where the prefix carries its closing underscore
in:       sb_publishable-0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_publishable-0123456789abcdef012345_01234567

case:     the prefix without its closing underscore
in:       sb_publishable0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_publishable0123456789abcdef012345_01234567

case:     a secret key
in:       sb_secret_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_secret_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567

# The two project keys with nothing standing between them rather than
# elsewhere in the text. Neither prefix reads inside the other's — this half's
# closes five characters and a second underscore later than the secret key's
# does — so a publishable key written straight against a secret key is
# located whole and the secret key beside it is left for that pattern alone.

case:     a secret key immediately followed by a publishable key
in:       sb_secret_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      sb_secret_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567«supabase-publishable-key»

case:     a publishable key immediately followed by a secret key
in:       sb_publishable_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567sb_secret_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      «supabase-publishable-key»sb_secret_0123456789abcdef012345_01234567

case:     a personal access token
in:       sbp_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      sbp_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a body of the right shape opening with no prefix
in:       xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx0123456789abcdef012345_01234567
out:      xxxxxxxxxxxxxxx0123456789abcdef012345_01234567

case:     prose
in:       there is no credential in this sentence
out:      there is no credential in this sentence

case:     a log line
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://api.supabase.co/rest/v1/todos
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://api.supabase.co/rest/v1/todos
